item.title: [Telugu] [OTT Release] Don't Trouble The Trouble
item.description:
Source91Mobiles OTT
LanguageTelugu
CategoryOTT Release
Release Date30 Oct 2026 (OTT)

Suri, a magician, performs tricks for a young girl named Divya, and they share a playful bond. However, things take a dramatic turn when the girl starts exhibiting genuine magical powers. Terrified by her supernatural abilities, Suri finds himself in a chaotic and humorous chase. It is later revealed that a magical lamp has been discovered, and a giant pink genie emerges, taking the form of the young girl.
